title: quercus cerris var. dentata
intro: Quercus cerris var. dentata, commonly known as the dentate Turkey oak, is a variant of the Quercus cerris species, a deciduous tree native to Eastern Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of Quercus cerris var. dentata include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its flavonoids, particularly quercetin, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Quercus cerris var. dentata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
